system.description: Ideology is everywhere. If you don't see it and try to control it, you're a puppet of those who do. You believe in something bigger than the daily grind of life in The Sprawl. You have a cause, a vision, or a mission... Perhaps it's a higher ideal: political change, social justice, revolution! Maybe it's simply to be the top dog in the junkyard. Whatever it is, when you start talking, people listen.
